output_list.criticism: Integer Overflow
The buyTokens function has an integer overflow, allowing the buyer to buy tokens without the price being displayed.
Wrong Logic
The buyTokens function logic is incorrect as it does not check the balance of the spender.
Bad Randomness
The buyTokens function randomally selects the sender address, which could result in unexpected token transfers.
Access Control
The buyTokens function does not check the user's access rights, allowing unauthorized token transfers.
Typo Constructor
The buyTokens function has a typo constructor, allowing unauthorized token transfers.
